name: Condition reports cost too much
summary: Cuts what a condition report costs in staff time by keeping the property and contact lists it needs current in the business's property system. The crons read only. The person still inspects, photographs, writes, and signs off every report.

all.evidence: 2 discovery calls describe this way of doing condition reports

covered_by.photos-and-notes: skill (photos and notes stay with the person)
covered_by.record-keeping: crons read the property and contact lists; the report record itself is a gap

crons.name: properties
crons.summary: Read the property list so a report starts from the right property.

crons.name: contacts
crons.summary: Read the contact list so a report goes to the right owner or tenant.

draft_ops_note: Reads only. Nothing in this workflow writes to a platform: the document upload endpoints are mapped but their body fields are not confirmed in the vendor docs, so they are a gap.
gaps: PropertyMe: its docs say it supports on-site inspections, photos, report sign-off and sending, but it has no kit platform folder, so nothing is built against it. Its Inspections help section returned HTTP 403.
Inspection Express and Inspection Manager, both used on the calls: integrator products with no kit platform folder.
rex: none of the 30 pages pulled describe condition reports, and it has no kit platform folder.
Property Tree and 360 cameras, both named on the calls: no kit platform folder.

AgentBox: the docs pulled do not describe condition reports. The document upload endpoints (post:/documents, post:/documents/signedUrl) are mapped in the kit, but their body fields are not in the vendor docs, so no upload or report write is built. A live account is needed.

AgentBox paging: the docs name pageSize and pageNumber, but the kit maps no params for get:/properties or get:/contacts, so the crons read the first page only. Changing the kit is out of scope for this workflow.
Meter and key readings, disputes, repairs and report sending: no confirmed AgentBox support. The person does these.
No draft or queue cron: no write has confirmed fields, so drafting and approval wait for a live account.
Judgment steps stay with the person: choosing photos, writing the report and signing it off.

evidence.calls: 3 calls read, 2 describe their process; the remaining call gave no process detail
evidence.platforms: the platform map for this job: PropertyMe partial, AgentBox unknown except its document endpoints, rex none. Only AgentBox has a kit folder.
